issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation 'nộp tôi cho họ' (hand me over to them) incorrectly interprets 'χαρισασθαι' (to grant/give/bestow). The Greek 'ουδεις με δυναται αυτοις χαρισασθαι' literally means 'no one is able to grant [anything] to them' in the context of the legal argument, rather than 'handing him over' to them.
